repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built in Python, providing a local-first dashboard to monitor agentic workflows.
Tracks granular metrics including work steps, tool usage, file modifications, and test execution.
Provides financial transparency by calculating exact token consumption and time spent per task.
Integrates with popular coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to audit agent productivity and ROI.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent LLM framework specifically designed for quantitative trading research.
bullets: Python-based architecture designed to orchestrate multiple LLM agents for financial analysis.
Focuses on automating the research pipeline for trading strategies, from data ingestion to hypothesis testing.
Enables complex reasoning tasks by delegating specific research components to specialized agent roles.
Useful for quant developers looking to integrate LLM-driven sentiment analysis and strategy backtesting.

repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, local-first dashboard for A-share market sentiment and short-term trading analysis.
bullets: Python-based dashboard that computes market sentiment metrics (e.g., limit-up pools, sentiment cycles) locally.
Separates data processing from AI; uses deterministic calculations for financial metrics and LLMs only for narrative synthesis.
Supports local execution, allowing users to bypass API costs by integrating with local models via Claude/Codex.
Ideal for retail or professional traders requiring real-time, privacy-focused market monitoring without external dependencies.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure tool for multimodal time-series data, built as a high-performance fork of Rerun.
bullets: Written in Rust, optimized for high-throughput ingestion and visualization of time-series data.
Native ROS 2 support allows for seamless integration into existing robotics and automated data pipelines.
Designed to handle complex, multi-sensor data streams with low latency, making it suitable for high-frequency trading backtesting or sensor fusion.
Provides a robust framework for replaying and analyzing historical data recordings (.rrd files) with advanced visual inspection.
